$comment: The platform levels, oldest first. A package states the lowest level it runs on in package.json (requires.platform), and a backend refuses a package that needs a level above its own. A published level never changes: what the platform adds goes in a new level at the end, with the day it landed. sharingUserFields lists the sharing-user fields a level added; the sharing-rule lint reads it to work out the level a package needs, and platform-level.gate.spec.ts holds it equal to the fields the backend attaches.

levels.summary: Every platform from before levels were counted, up to commit 90b2944bf. Its manifest schema has no requires.platform, so it refuses a package that states one.
Sharing rules can read whether the caller may work in every scope (allScopes) and which of the permissions the deck's rules name the caller holds (holds).
